title: Trump Discusses Ukraine War End with Putin
text:
Trump⁤ Engages in Secret Talks with Putin to End Ukraine⁣ Conflict In a recent interview conducted aboard the Air Force One presidential aircraft, US President Donald Trump revealed that ‌he has been in communication⁣ with Russian President Vladimir putin to discuss the cessation of‍ hostilities in Ukraine.The disclosure, reported by ‌BTA,⁣ comes as a notable growth in the ongoing conflict that has claimed thousands of lives since ⁣its inception.
When questioned‍ about the frequency ⁢of his conversations‍ with Putin, Trump remained elusive, stating, “It’s better not to say.” This ambiguity underscores the sensitive nature of ⁣the diplomatic⁢ efforts being undertaken behind closed doors. Trump emphasized that Putin’s primary concern is the cessation of‌ casualties, asserting, “He [Putin] wants to‌ see‌ that people stop dying.”
The Kremlin , however, has been less forthcoming about thes ‍discussions. Dmitry Peskov, the‌ Russian presidential press ⁤secretary, declined to confirm or deny the reports, stating, “What can we say​ about this news: insofar as the government in Washington unfolds its work, a very different communication arises. And this communication is conducted on different channels. And‍ of course,against the background of the‌ intensity of this communication I may ​not know something,I am​ not familiar with something.”
Last month, Peskov had indicated that Putin was prepared to engage ⁢in a telephone conversation with Trump, awaiting an initiative from Washington. This latest revelation suggests that such a dialog has indeed ⁣taken place.
Trump also hinted at an⁢ upcoming meeting with Ukrainian ⁤President Volodymyr ⁣zelenski. Scheduled for ‍next week, the meeting aims⁣ to discuss the end of the war and commemorate ⁢its third anniversary on February‍ 24. noted that the conflict has resulted in the deaths of thousands, predominantly Ukrainians. Trump expressed ⁤his desire to conclude ⁤the conflict‍ swiftly, stating, “Every⁤ day people die. This war is so bad for Ukraine. I want to put an end to this damn thing.”
Along with his efforts to broker peace in Ukraine, Trump discussed ⁣his stance ​on Iran. He expressed⁣ a preference for negotiating a nuclear deal with Tehran over military action. “I would prefer that to bomb⁤ it …‍ They don’t want to die. No ⁣one ⁣wants to die,” ⁣Trump told the New York Post. He‍ further suggested that ⁤such ​a deal could deter Israel ⁤from ‌taking military action against Iran, stating, “If we make a deal, Israel will not bomb them.”
Though, Trump was cautious about divulging the specifics of any⁤ negotiations with Iran. He refused to⁢ disclose what the US might​ offer‌ Tehran⁢ in return, stating, “I can’t say this as it’s too ⁢unpleasant. I won’t bomb them.”
